title: Company overview
keywords: what does company overview business industries clients offerings services do provide who founder uriyah small business
text: HEURIAL Studio is a small AI workflow studio founded by Uriyah Moore. It helps small businesses take repetitive work off their plate, like lead follow-up, answering the same customer questions, copying information between tools, scattered notes, and weekly reporting, with small AI-powered workflows built around the tools they already use.

title: Founding offer and pricing
keywords: price prices pricing cost costs how much offer founding 495 295 895 packages package quick fix two workflows dollars pay payment deposit 49 cheap cheapest plan starter small budget
text:
HEURIAL has three fixed prices, and a $49 way to start.
Workflow plan: $49. A one-page plan for one task; the $49 comes off any package.
Quick fix: $295.
One workflow: $495 for the first three clients.
Two connected workflows: $895.
Each is 50% to start and 50% at handoff. Any tool subscriptions are billed to your own accounts and disclosed up front.

title: What each package includes
keywords: packages package include includes included deliverables get receive timeline long take takes week weeks days quick fix one workflow two workflows
text:
Quick fix: one simple automation, done in a few days, with 7 days of support.
One workflow: one useful workflow in your existing tools, about one week from kickoff. You receive a simple map of how the task works today, one working automation or assistant, setup inside your own tools, a plain-English guide, a handoff call, and 14 days of support.
Two workflows: two connected workflows, about two weeks, with 30 days of support.

title: Starting a project
keywords: start started starting getting contact consultation discovery project process engagement kick off hire talk prepare submit inquiry book call free 20-minute
text: Book a free 20-minute call from the Contact page. Describe the task that eats up your time and the tools you use for it today. On the call, HEURIAL will say honestly whether it can help, and if it's a fit, you'll get a short written scope before any work starts.

title: Your data and ownership
keywords: data safe safety secure security privacy password passwords own ownership access ai services openai trust
text: You own everything HEURIAL builds, and it lives in your accounts. HEURIAL never asks for your passwords; you invite it as a user instead. It only touches the data a task needs, and before work starts it tells you which AI services your data will pass through. If HEURIAL isn't the right fit, it will say so.

title: Workflow automation
keywords: automate automation automated workflow workflows approvals triggers repetitive integrations tools
text: HEURIAL can scope and build automations for repetitive business workflows. An automation plan defines the trigger, systems involved, permitted actions, approval steps, and what happens if something fails. Human review can be built in for exceptions or consequential actions.

title: Retrieval-based assistants
keywords: rag retrieval assistant assistants knowledge document documents citations chatbot chatbots bot bots sources grounded faq faqs questions answers guides
text: A knowledge assistant looks up relevant passages from an approved set of documents before answering, and links to the passages it used. HEURIAL can build one around your own FAQs or guides so customers or staff stop asking the same questions. The assistant on this site is a demo that answers from these public guides.

title: After handoff
keywords: after handoff support ongoing maintenance maintain fix fixes breaks break broken later changes change help guide days
text: Support after handoff is included: 7 days with a quick fix, 14 days with one workflow, and 30 days with two workflows. One workflow and two workflows also come with a plain-English guide that explains how the workflow works and what to check. After that, you can ask HEURIAL for small fixes or another workflow.

title: Follow-up tracker demo
keywords: demo tracker follow-up followup follow leads pipeline board reminders daily email sample interactive try
text: The follow-up tracker is shown here as an interactive demo on made-up sample data. It lists new website inquiries, calls that need a status update and follow-ups that are due. A Pipeline board lets you drag leads between stages, and Email preview shows the daily summary. Nothing in the demo is saved or sent.
